sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Make Amends - Security is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "These are difficult times we live in, indeed. I can help you regain Lightkeeper's trust. I don't see the point in having a conflict. So, he wants wireless cameras placed around the perimeter of the Rogue base, apparently, for security purposes. Try to stay away from the base itself - I don't think Rogues know that you're acquainted with their friend."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Getting the Digital secure DSP radio transmitter decoded the second time.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Place a WI-FI Camera at the yellow bus on the southern bridge approaching the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
- Place a WI-FI Camera at the yellow bulldozer in the south-eastern part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
- Place a WI-FI Camera at the police truck in the western part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
- Place a WI-FI Camera at the army truck near the industrial zone in the northern part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
"The cameras are set up, the signal is coming through. Lightkeeper is happy, which is great news."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| WI-FI Camera | 4 | Required | N/A | Can be purchased from Mechanic LL1. |
In this quest you have to place 4 WI-FI Cameras at different vehicles around the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.
